places.name: Jardin Exotique de Monaco
places.ai_summary: A stunning botanical garden featuring exotic plants and breathtaking views of Monaco and the Mediterranean.
places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes for the trails.

places.name: Observation Cave (Grotte de l’Observatoire)
places.ai_summary: A fascinating cave with stalactites and stalagmites, located within the Exotic Garden.
places.place_tip: Bring a jacket as it can be cool inside.

places.name: Monaco Top Viewpoint Terrace
places.ai_summary: A panoramic terrace offering the best views of Monaco’s skyline and the Mediterranean Sea.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during sunrise or sunset.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera for stunning photos.

places.name: Villa Paloma (New National Museum of Monaco)
places.ai_summary: An art museum housed in a beautiful villa, featuring contemporary art exhibitions and a stunning garden.
places.place_tip: Check for temporary exhibitions.

places.name: Villa Sauber (Art Museum)
places.ai_summary: An art museum featuring a collection of modern and contemporary art, located in a charming villa.
places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to Villa Paloma.

places.name: Princess Antoinette Park
places.ai_summary: A public park with beautiful gardens, a playground, and a mini-golf course, perfect for families.
places.place_tip: Great spot for a picnic.

places.name: Saint Devote Valley View
places.ai_summary: A scenic viewpoint overlooking the Saint Devote Valley, offering stunning views and photo opportunities.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during sunrise or sunset.

places.place_tip: Watch out for the best photography angles.

places.name: Avenue Hector Otto Scenic Route
places.ai_summary: A scenic road offering a beautiful drive or walk with stunning views of the coastline and the Mediterranean.

opening_hours.notes: Best enjoyed by car or bike.

places.place_tip: Drive slowly to take in the views.

places.name: Exotic Garden Cactus Trails
places.ai_summary: Unique trails within the Exotic Garden, featuring a variety of cacti and succulent plants.
places.place_tip: Don't forget your camera.

places.name: Panorama over Fontvieille
places.ai_summary: A breathtaking viewpoint overlooking the Fontvieille district, the harbor, and the Mediterranean Sea.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during sunrise or sunset.

places.place_tip: Ideal for photography and relaxation.

places.name: Boulevard du Jardin Exotique Walk
places.ai_summary: A pleasant walk along the Boulevard du Jardin Exotique, offering beautiful views and access to various attractions.

opening_hours.notes: Enjoy the gardens and views along the way.

places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to the Exotic Garden.

places.ai_summary: The entrance to the Monaco Observatory Cave, offering guided tours to explore the fascinating underground world.
places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes.

places.name: Jardin Exotique Cafeteria Terrace
places.ai_summary: A terrace cafeteria located within the Exotic Garden, offering refreshments and snacks with a view.
places.place_tip: Try the local pastries.

places.name: National Museum of Fine Arts (Villa Paloma)
places.ai_summary: A museum dedicated to fine arts, located in the Villa Paloma, featuring works from the Renaissance to the 20th century.
places.place_tip: Check for guided tours.

places.name: Panoramic Elevator Descent to La Condamine
places.ai_summary: A unique elevator ride offering panoramic views of Monaco as you descend to the La Condamine district.
places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to the Exotic Garden.

places.name: Sunset Viewpoint at Exotic Garden
places.ai_summary: A popular viewpoint within the Exotic Garden, offering stunning views of the sunset over the Mediterranean.
places.place_tip: Arrive early to secure a good spot.

places.name: Rock Path Trail Connection
places.ai_summary: A connecting trail within the Exotic Garden, leading to various points of interest including the Cactus Trails and the Sunset Viewpoint.
places.place_tip: Follow the signs for points of interest.

places.name: Rue Bellevue Lookout Point
places.ai_summary: A lookout point on Rue Bellevue, offering a different perspective of the Monaco coastline and the Mediterranean.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during sunrise or sunset.

places.place_tip: Explore the surrounding area for more views.

places.name: Avenue Pasteur Stair Path
places.ai_summary: A stair path on Avenue Pasteur, providing access to higher viewpoints and the Exotic Garden.

opening_hours.notes: Best for morning or late afternoon visits.

places.place_tip: Take your time and enjoy the views.

places.name: Garden Shop & Museum Boutique
places.ai_summary: A shop and boutique located within the Exotic Garden, offering a range of plants, souvenirs, and garden-related products.
places.place_tip: Great place to find unique souvenirs.
